caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The chair has four curved legs and an ornate backrest with intricate carvings at the top. The seat of the chair is padded and covered in a dark, possibly black or dark gray material. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with visible lines indicating wood grain and texture. The composition is symmetrical, with the chair oriented to face directly toward the viewer, and the entire chair fits neatly within a lightly outlined rectangular frame. There is a small text in the bottom left corner, likely the artist’s signature, reading "Emil M. Märgner."
title: Fiddle-back Chair
